title: Opaque id can be substituted to read another tenant's object (needs two accounts)
summary: A UUID or opaque id can be swapped for another to read an object that is not the caller's.  Needs a second account to prove, so it skips until two accounts are configured.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.

reproduce: As account A, request an object id known to belong to account B.
remediate: Check object ownership on the server for every object level read.
